_derivation.note: The Strava Clubs domain is a STATIC, fully-enumerable swagger schema (no per-account custom fields). official_fields.json transcribes the DetailedClub/SummaryClub/ClubActivity/ClubAthlete/DetailedAthlete models directly from https://developers.strava.com/swagger/swagger.json (+ activity.json for the SportType enum). There is NO enrichment source (Strava is not a Supermetrics source; tap-strava covers athlete/activities, not clubs), so the swagger is the sole authority -- sufficient because the schema is small and static. field_discovery.mode=static. Completeness is proven by this transcription (no dynamic layer, no truncated superset).
_derivation.central_design_fact: SNAPSHOT-ONLY, NO HISTORY. GET /clubs/{id} returns the current value only. member_count/following_count are NON-ADDITIVE point-in-time levels (aggregation_rule=latest); the connector owns the time-series by snapshotting daily into a dated fact. Pre-connection history is unrecoverable.
_derivation.competitor_boundary: GET /clubs/{id} does NOT require membership -> any PUBLIC club is snapshotable by id. Private clubs 404 (skipped, never a zero). No club search endpoint -> competitor ids are per-project config. members/admins/activities are membership-gated -> competitors expose metadata+counts only.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://developers.strava.com/swagger/swagger.json -o /tmp/strava-sources/swagger.json ; curl -sL https://developers.strava.com/swagger/activity.json -o /tmp/strava-sources/activity.json   # activity.json carries the SportType enum

_also._note: Clubs section: getClubById (DetailedClub), getLoggedInAthleteClubs (SummaryClub[]), getClubMembersById (ClubAthlete[]), getClubAdminsById (SummaryAthlete[]), getClubActivitiesById (ClubActivity[]).
OAuth2 authorization_code, scope 'read' covers club feeds. Access token 6h; refresh token rotates.
Default 100 reads/15min, 1000 reads/day. 429 (sometimes 403) on breach; honor Retry-After.

_field_discovery.note: Fixed swagger schema, no per-account custom fields. The full field set is committed in api_catalog.json. Declared in manifest source_capabilities.field_discovery.

_non_additive_metrics.note: member_count / following_count / post_count are POINT-IN-TIME LEVELS. aggregation_rule=latest (manifest canonical_metric_mapping), non_additive=true. Read as last value per (club_id, window) via QUALIFY supersede -- NEVER SUM. They live in the DEDICATED mart fact_strava_club_snapshot, NOT in the additive cross-source fact_daily_kpi (GSC average_position precedent: a non-additive metric has no honest SUM row in the central mart).

probe.structural_note: GET /clubs/{id} for a KNOWN PUBLIC club id (supplied at ratification): the response object carries every DetailedClub field -> each cataloged club field records ok|empty by presence in the JSON. No per-field request to bisect (one GET returns the whole object). own_club_full additionally probes GET /athlete/clubs and, for one own-club id, /members|/admins|/activities. A 404 on a deliberately-absent/private club id confirms the competitor unreachable path.
